subject: [PATCH 1/4] kernfs: Use VFS lookup context in d_revalidate()

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch modifies the kernfs revalidation callback to use VFS-provided lookup context instead of recovering information from mutable dentry fields. The patch also prepares the callback for lockless operation by comparing names using their explicit length, which may point into the pathname and need not be terminated at name->len. This change is intended to improve stability and performance in concurrent rename scenarios.
